about_the_game:
Dive into a thrilling world of treacherous dungeons, and endless combat! Knight of the Dungeon is a heart-pounding fusion of Rogue-Like and Bullet-Hell, with procedurally generated rooms.

Key Features

  • Endless Dungeons - Explore ever-changing levels filled with secrets, traps and treasures. No two playthroughs will be the same!

  • Dynamic Combat - Fight hordes of monsters and mighty bosses while dodging spaces. Reflexes and strategy are your best allies!

  • Progress and loot - in each new location you will find new weapons and magical artifacts that will change your style of play.

  • Small inventory size - you only have three slots. Use them wisely!

  • Pleasant visual component - pleasant pixel graphics will accompany you throughout the game.

  • A World of Magic and Mystery - Discover ancient spells, interact with mysterious NPCs and uncover the history of this dangerous world.

Get ready for challenges and adventures, your journey begins right now!
